pages.title: Finding Ignatius
pages.text: Default deposits: Nether, Y 32 to 96. Veins target up to 8 blocks, with 10 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 3.

pages.title: Working Ignatius
pages.text: Smelt Ignatius Ore or Ignatius Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 84 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 4.$(br)Mining efficiency: 4.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 2.4.$(br)Enchantability: 11.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 2, chestplate 4, leggings 3, boots 2.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 0.0.$(br)Enchantability: 11.

pages.title: Tool: Molten Core
pages.text: Auto-smelts block drops if they can be smelted.$(br2)Auto-smelt chance is based on the Fortune enchantment

pages.title: Weapon: Molten Blade
pages.text: Auto-smelts entity loot if they can be smelted.$(br2)Auto-smelt chance is based on the Fortune enchantment

pages.title: Armor: Hot-Blooded
pages.text: Fire and lava heals you proportionally to the damage it would otherwise deal, but water and rain damages you as if it were lava and fire; $(br2)The effect of Fire Protection is inverted, to protect water damage.
